newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P assigns A-2 rating to Foreningsbanken.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns A-2 rating to Foreningsbanken.

text.p: U.S. credit ratings agency Standard & Poor's said on Friday it assigned an A-2 short-term counterparty rating to Sweden's Foreningsbanken.

The agency said the rating was based on the bank's solid provincial franchise and adequate capitalisation. "These positive factors are offset, however, by weak asset quality which caused the bank to post major losses in the early 1990s.
S&P said however that Foreningsbanken's asset quality trend was improving.
S&P said the bank's capital position was now at a comparable level with that of the largest four banks in the Swedish market.
"Foreningsbanken has undergone extensive restructuring and rationalisation in the past three years and is now well placed to provide the services and products needed by its customers.
"However aggressive competitors, eager to grow their market share, will challenge Foreningsbanken's ability to sustain its position in loans and deposits," S&P added.
